title: Raksan Transformers IPO Details
intro:
Raksan Transformers IPO is a book build issue of ₹150.50 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 44.13 lakh shares aggregating to ₹120.47 crores and offer for sale of 11.00 lakh shares aggregating to ₹30.03 crores.

Raksan Transformers IPO opens for subscription on Sep 10, 2026 and closes on Sep 15, 2026. The allotment for the Raksan Transformers IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 16, 2026. Raksan Transformers IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 18, 2026.

Raksan Transformers IPO is set issue price band at ₹258 to ₹273 per share. The lot size for an application is 400 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,18,400 (800 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (1,200 shares), amounting to ₹3,27,600.

Hem Securities Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Hem Finlease Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Raksan Transformers IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in July 1995, Raksan Transformers Limited is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer of transformers across different voltage ratings. The Company manufactures a diversified range of transformers, including distribution transformers, power transformers, transformers for solar applications and special purpose transformers, which are used across power generation, transmission and distribution networks, as well as various industrial and infrastructure projects. The Company initially focused on the repair and servicing of distribution and power transformers and subsequently commenced transformer manufacturing in 2005-06. It has since expanded its operations to two manufacturing facilities in Rai, Sonepat, Haryana.

As of March 31, 2026, the Company operates through two manufacturing units spread across approximately 2,025 sq. mtrs. and 1,012.5 sq. mtrs., with a combined installed production capacity of approximately 15,00,000 KVA for distribution transformers and 1,350 MVA for power transformers. The facilities are equipped with machinery for core cutting, coil winding, assembly, tank fabrication, oil filtration, welding and testing. The Company also has in-house facilities for core cutting/slitting, wire or strip drawing and tank fabrication, along with an in-house testing laboratory for conducting routine and type tests.

Raksan Transformers serves a diverse customer base comprising government entities, power distribution corporations, public sector undertakings, utility companies, EPC contractors and industrial clients. The Company is an approved vendor for more than 20 entities, including power distribution corporations, PSUs and public utility companies. Its manufacturing process incorporates quality control measures at various stages and uses key raw materials such as CRGO steel, copper and aluminium conductors, transformer oil, insulating materials and fabricated transformer tanks. Its group company, SHR Powers Private Limited, manufactures transformer tanks/bodies, supporting the Company's backward integration and supply chain efficiency.

The Company's products are manufactured in compliance with applicable Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) requirements, and the Company is authorized to use the ISI mark on applicable products. Several products are also certified under the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) STAR rating programme. The Company focuses on designing transformers according to customer-specific requirements, including voltage, power, climatic conditions, system configuration and sound levels.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 143 full-time employees, including 113 employees in production, along with personnel across designing and quality control, finance, purchase and stores, sales and marketing, and HR and administration.
strengths: Focus on quality assurance and regulatory compliance.
Established manufacturing facilities and in-house operations.
Track record of profitability and consistent financial performance.
Backward integration supporting supply chain and cost efficiency
Established relationships with government entities and power utilities.

faqs.question: How to apply in Raksan Transformers IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Raksan Transformers IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Raksan Transformers IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Raksan Transformers IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Raksan Transformers IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: You can apply in Raksan Transformers IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account.
